[
  {"step":1,"file":"libsepol/tests/policies/test-linker/small-base.conf","function":"<global>","line":461,"var":"optional block o1_b","code":"optional { ... type tag_o1_b; ... role o1_b_role_1; ... }","note":"Attacker-controlled policy text introduces an optional block whose contents are copied into the AST only if its requirements are met."},
  {"step":2,"file":"libsepol/tests/policies/test-linker/module1.conf","function":"<global>","line":71,"var":"optional block o1_m1","code":"optional { ... type tag_o1_m1; ... role o1_m1_role_1; ... }","note":"A second optional block in a module creates another block node that can participate in blockinherit resolution and nesting."},
  {"step":3,"file":"libsepol/cil/src/cil_build_ast.c","function":"cil_gen_optional","line":5413,"var":"ast_node->flavor","code":"else if (parse_current->data == CIL_KEY_OPTIONAL) { rc = cil_gen_optional(db, parse_current, ast_node); }","note":"The parser turns each optional statement into a CIL_OPTIONAL AST node, preserving the attacker-controlled nesting structure."},
  {"step":4,"file":"libsepol/cil/src/cil_resolve_ast.c","function":"cil_resolve_blockinherit_copy","line":2400,"var":"item->data","code":"rc = cil_check_recursive_blockinherit(item->data);","note":"During linking/copying, blockinherit nodes are checked for recursion before their contents are merged into the destination block."},
  {"step":5,"file":"libsepol/cil/src/cil_resolve_ast.c","function":"cil_check_recursive_blockinherit","line":2367,"var":"bi_node","code":"for (curr = bi_node->parent; curr != NULL; curr = curr->parent) { if (curr->flavor != CIL_BLOCK) continue; ... }","note":"The recursion check walks parent pointers upward from the current blockinherit node to find an enclosing block with the same target block."},
  {"step":6,"file":"libsepol/cil/src/cil_resolve_ast.c","function":"cil_check_recursive_blockinherit","line":2388,"var":"curr","code":"cil_print_recursive_blockinherit(bi_node, curr);","note":"When a recursive blockinherit is detected, the code prints the ancestry trace for the offending path."},
  {"step":7,"file":"libsepol/cil/src/cil_resolve_ast.c","function":"cil_print_recursive_blockinherit","line":2335,"var":"curr->flavor","code":"for (curr = bi_node; curr != terminating_node; curr = curr->parent) { if (curr->flavor == CIL_BLOCK) ... else { ... ((struct cil_blockinherit *)curr->data)->block ... } }","note":"This printer assumes every non-CIL_BLOCK ancestor is a CIL_BLOCKINHERIT and dereferences curr->data as struct cil_blockinherit."},
  {"step":8,"file":"libsepol/cil/src/cil_resolve_ast.c","function":"cil_print_recursive_blockinherit","line":2348,"var":"((struct cil_blockinherit *)curr->data)->block","code":"cil_list_prepend(trace, CIL_NODE, NODE(((struct cil_blockinherit *)curr->data)->block));","note":"If the ancestry contains an optional or other non-block node, this cast reads past the real object layout, causing the heap out-of-bounds read."}
]
JSON
